canonical_refs.surface: src#client admin gating and HTML sinks

local_checks.invariant: HTML sinks never render data a lower-trust user controls without sanitizing.
local_checks.result: Enumerated dangerouslySetInnerHTML, innerHTML, srcDoc and insertAdjacentHTML in src. Student-writable surfaces (messages, journal, reading-center) render as text or markdown without rehype-raw. Gmail bodies (external senders) go through DOMPurify (GmailMessageBody harden); TA drafts, ActionCard notes, taPdf and canvas exports sanitize with DOMPurify. Unsanitized sinks (bootcamp lesson constants, classroom content_html srcDoc in a sandbox without allow-same-origin, noteExcerpt/PostedRecapsList detached innerHTML) render admin-authored classroom content, and the classroom_items guard trigger blocks students from editing content_html/description.

local_checks.invariant: Client-only admin gates are backed by server enforcement.
local_checks.result: Held for the sampled admin data: admin pages read tables whose RLS requires has_role(admin). Access flags are checked client-side but the flag values themselves are writable on INSERT (see lsatu:rls:profiles-insert-unguarded-access-flags-self-grant).

x_hardening: get_or_create_personal_plan(uuid) (20260701180000) is SECURITY DEFINER with no caller check and keeps default PUBLIC EXECUTE; any caller can create a '__personal__' weekly_plans row for any student id. Add p_student = auth.uid() or admin check and REVOKE from PUBLIC, anon.

search_teaching_assets, search_guided_drill_sets and list_section_activities return excerpts/metadata of admin-only tables to any authenticated user; acceptable only if that content is meant for students.
get_user_class_id, can_sit_practice_test and booking_slot_is_clear keep default PUBLIC EXECUTE; revoke from anon.

Students can UPDATE status/score columns on their own homework_assignments, activity_assignments, ta_assignments and practice_test_runs rows (same-principal integrity); consider guard triggers like the classroom_items one.

noteExcerpt in src/components/classroom/ClassroomRouteViews.tsx and PostedRecapsList assign classroom content to innerHTML of a detached div, which still fires img onerror; content is admin/LLM-authored today, but use DOMParser or DOMPurify before extracting text.
Drop the legacy 'Users can ...' policies from 20251022025825 regardless of the class_id candidate outcome; two parallel policy generations make the effective policy hard to audit.
teacher_message_templates policies from 20260522152939 apply to role PUBLIC and let any authenticated user create templates for themselves; scope to admin if templates are teacher-only.

local_checks.invariant: Every verify_jwt=false function has its own gate
local_checks.result: Listed: preview-transactional-email, public-booking, booking-upload, gemini-proxy, gcal-sync-pull, gcal-reconcile, booking-pass, booking-commerce-webhook, single-session, single-session-sweeper, single-session-outbox, mcp, sweep-rrc-grading. Each traced below.

local_checks.invariant: Internal LLM proxy rejects callers without EDGE_INTERNAL_KEY and fails closed when it is unset
local_checks.result: Holds: internalKey defaults to empty string and the guard rejects when it is empty; constant-time compare; model pinned server-side. No open LLM spend.

local_checks.invariant: Stripe events verified with constructEventAsync and the dedicated webhook secret; Cal.com HMAC over raw body with constant-time compare; both fail closed
local_checks.result: Holds: requiredEnv throws for STRIPE_BOOKING_WEBHOOK_SECRET and CALCOM_BOOKING_WEBHOOK_SECRET, raw body read before parse, Stripe tolerance 300s, safeEqual for Cal.com, livemode checked against STRIPE_LIVEMODE.

local_checks.invariant: Duplicate Stripe delivery cannot double-grant package credits or double-finalize a single session
local_checks.result: Holds in source: auto_grant_stripe_payment locks the stripe_payments row FOR UPDATE and returns early unless grant_state='awaiting'; admin notice only when the ledger row is newly inserted; finalize_single_session_payment receives the provider event id; Cal.com upserts keyed on provider_booking_id and provider_event_id.

local_checks.invariant: Worker endpoints require BOOKING_WORKER_SECRET (constant time, fail closed when empty), service-role bearer, single-use DB ticket, or admin JWT
local_checks.result: Holds: sweeper and sweep-rrc-grading use requiredEnv (throws when unset); outbox returns false when expected is empty; gcal-reconcile requires workerKey.length>0 (plain === compare, hardening only); gcal-sync-pull accepts ticket, service role, or admin role.

local_checks.invariant: Template preview gated by LOVABLE_API_KEY and fails closed
local_checks.result: Holds: 500 when key unset, 401 on mismatch (non-constant-time compare, hardening). Renders only static previewData.

local_checks.invariant: Retired or scratch functions expose nothing
local_checks.result: booking-pass returns 410 only; mcp-scratch returns version and timestamp only.

local_checks.invariant: MCP tools act only with the caller's own token and admin tools re-check admin
local_checks.result: Holds: OAuth issuer pinned to the project ref with audience 'authenticated'; every tool uses an anon-key client carrying the caller's bearer so RLS applies; self tools filter by ctx.getUserId(); admin RPCs call mcp_require_admin(); list tools call requireAdmin.

local_checks.invariant: Anonymous slug caller reads only its own pass and no PII; slug is unguessable
local_checks.result: Holds: slug tail is 26 chars from a 31-char alphabet via getRandomValues (about 128 bits); info DTO omits email, name and slug; redemptions filtered by the resolved pass id; invalid-slug lockout per IP hash; identity comes only from the pass row.

local_checks.invariant: Anonymous uploads bound to the resolved pass, size and type limited, storage key confined
local_checks.result: Holds for binding and limits: 5 files, 20 MB each, 60 MB total, extension allowlist plus MIME blocklist, key prefix booking/<pass.id>/; discard and adopt lookups filter by pass id; cleanup requires service key or EDGE_INTERNAL_KEY and an unset env var (undefined) never equals the empty header. idempotency_key and client_upload_id characters are unconstrained in the key (hardening note).

local_checks.invariant: Turnstile fails closed and an anonymous hold cannot obtain another person's negotiated price
local_checks.result: Turnstile holds (requiredEnv TURNSTILE_SECRET throws when unset; success===true required). Price binding fails: booking_price_cents applies booking_price_overrides keyed on the caller-typed, unverified email; the quote is persisted from that email and the webhook validates payment against that quote. Candidate single-session/hold/booking_price_cents-keyed-on-unverified-caller-email.

local_checks.invariant: Lovable email-event webhook verifies its sender
local_checks.result: Signature check is delegated to @lovable.dev/email-js createEmailWebhookHandler with LOVABLE_API_KEY; library internals and the deployed verify_jwt default for this function (absent from config.toml) are not visible. Writes are limited to suppression and audit rows. Recorded as hardening, not a candidate.

x_hardening: booking-upload cleanup compares the service-role key and EDGE_INTERNAL_KEY with !== (non-constant time); gcal-reconcile compares X-Worker-Secret with ===; preview-transactional-email compares LOVABLE_API_KEY with !==. All fail closed when the env var is unset; switch to the constant-time helper used elsewhere.

booking-upload places idempotency_key (8-200 chars) and client_upload_id (8-100 chars) into the storage key with no character restriction, so '/' and '..' segments are accepted under booking/<pass_id>/. Hosted S3 keys are literal, so no escape was shown; restrict both to [A-Za-z0-9-].

booking-upload resolves the slug before any rate limit and does not count misses toward the invalid-slug lockout that public-booking applies; slugs carry about 128 bits, so this is not exploitable today.
public-booking and booking-upload key their throttles on the first X-Forwarded-For hop, which the client controls; single-session already prefers cf-connecting-ip or the last hop.

handle-email-events is not listed in supabase/config.toml and delegates signature verification to @lovable.dev/email-js; confirm the deployed verify_jwt mode and that the library rejects unsigned events (writes are limited to suppressed_emails and email_send_log).

booking-commerce-webhook (Cal.com branch) matches a student by a unique case-insensitive display_name when the attendee email does not match, then mirrors a Calendar event for that student; attendee fields are booker-typed, so a stranger's booking can be misattributed to a student.

single-session hold replay returns the original booking_token (decrypted from the checkout fingerprint success_url) to any caller presenting the same client_idempotency_key; safe only while that key stays client-random.
study-chat forwards client-supplied messages with arbitrary roles (including system) to the model; same-principal only, with no tools or data access.

local_checks.invariant: Tool-calling agents that act with service-role authority are reachable only by admins
local_checks.result: Holds: verifyAdmin (getUser then user_roles admin) runs before body parse and before any tool dispatch; teacher-operator-chat checks admin before reading the payload. Tool student arguments are admin-chosen; no student principal reaches these tools.

local_checks.invariant: Student-facing chats have no tool path to other students' data and scope reads to the JWT user
local_checks.result: Holds: no tools are sent; tutor-chat reads attempts with .eq('user_id', user.id) and writes events for user.id; activity-coach grades with the verified user id; voice-coach-respond and motivation-engine authenticate via getUser and do not use the service role.

local_checks.invariant: No cross-session context bleed through in-memory caches
local_checks.result: knowledgeCache is keyed by qid and holds shared question knowledge only, not per-user data.

surface: JWT edge functions using the service role
boundary: Caller role check before privileged action

local_checks.invariant: Shared verifier rejects missing, invalid, or sub-less tokens
local_checks.result: Holds: getClaims on an anon client verifies the signature locally; returns null on error or missing sub, so anon-key JWTs are rejected.

local_checks.invariant: Admin-surface functions authenticate and check the admin role before any service-role read or write
local_checks.result: Holds: each verifies the JWT (getClaims, getUser or userFromRequest) then requires a user_roles admin row or has_role(admin) before acting; failures return 401 or 403.

local_checks.invariant: Student-callable service-role functions bind request-supplied ids to the caller
local_checks.result: Holds: section_history.user_id must equal the caller; upload.student_id owner or admin; assignment.student_id owner or admin (service-role bearer compared in constant time); onboarding default path uses the caller's own class_id and sweep requires admin; knowledge bodies and higher limits require admin or the internal key (fail closed when empty).

local_checks.invariant: A booking pass issued to an email attaches only to an account that has proven control of that email
local_checks.result: Fails in source unless Auth enforces email confirmation: student-booking attaches any account-less active pass whose student_email matches the JWT email claim; linkPassToAccount and findAuthUserIdByEmail match listUsers emails without checking email_confirmed_at. config.toml has no [auth] section, so the deployed confirmation setting is not visible. Candidate booking-pass/email-auto-link-trusts-unverified-account-email.

local_checks.invariant: Service-role clients in student functions use the verified user id
local_checks.result: Holds: study-chat only calls getUser (its Authorization override makes the client act as the user); activity-coach passes _au.user.id; tutor-chat filters attempts by user.id and reads only shared knowledge.

local_checks.invariant: CORS '*' combined with cookie credentials
local_checks.result: Not reportable: functions use bearer tokens, not cookies, and send no Access-Control-Allow-Credentials.

local_checks.invariant: Every table holding user data has RLS enabled in the final migrated state.
local_checks.result: Replayed all 344 migrations in filename order with a statement parser (CREATE/DROP POLICY, ENABLE RLS, CREATE TABLE/DROP TABLE). All 156 public tables end with RLS enabled (three reading_center tables enable it through dynamic SQL in 20261013220000). Tables with RLS and zero policies (activity_ai_*_v1, booking_link_hits, booking_worker_heartbeats, single_session_*) are deny-all to clients.

local_checks.invariant: No final policy grants anon or authenticated USING(true)/WITH CHECK(true) on user-owned data.
local_checks.result: USING(true) survives only on content/reference tables (lr_*, rc_* question bank, concept_library, question_type_strategies, reasoning_type_guidance, tactical_patterns, question_tutor_cache, achievements legacy read). The 2025 USING(true) student policies were dropped by name in 20260406153113.

local_checks.invariant: Owner identity used by RLS (class_id) cannot be chosen by the caller.
local_checks.result: Violated (candidate lsatu:rls:students.class_id-self-writable-feeds-legacy-get_user_class_id-policies): legacy policies named 'Users can ...' in 20251022025825 bind rows to get_user_class_id(auth.uid()), which reads students.class_id; 20260406153113 dropped only the 'Students can ...' names, so both sets OR together. students INSERT/UPDATE policies check only user_id and no column grant or trigger protects students.class_id.

local_checks.invariant: Admin-controlled profile fields (has_*_access, access_tier, archived_at, proficiency_level) cannot be set by the student.
local_checks.result: Violated on INSERT (candidate lsatu:rls:profiles-insert-unguarded-access-flags-self-grant): guard_profile_admin_fields is a BEFORE UPDATE trigger only, column-scoped grants were applied to UPDATE only, and the student INSERT policy checks only class_id = auth.uid()::text. Profiles are first created by a client upsert, so a new signup can create its own row with every access flag true, bypassing the approve_signup admin queue.

local_checks.invariant: A user can only become a conversation participant through admin or creator action.
local_checks.result: Violated (candidate lsatu:rls:conversation_participants-update-conversation_id-pivot): 'Users can update own participant row' checks user_id only and leaves conversation_id writable; no column grant or trigger restricts it. Moving one's own row to another conversation id makes is_conversation_participant true for that conversation, opening messages, attachments rows, storage objects and inserts. conversations UPDATE also lacks WITH CHECK, letting a participant rewrite created_by.

local_checks.invariant: Student UPDATE policies cannot rewrite owner or role columns.
local_checks.result: Held for profiles (column grants plus guard trigger block class_id and flags), classroom_items (guard trigger), user_roles (admin-only FOR ALL). Self-row UPDATEs on homework_assignments, activity_assignments, practice_test_runs, ta_assignments let a student alter status/score of their own rows (same-principal integrity; listed as hardening).

local_checks.invariant: Views exposed through PostgREST run as invoker.
local_checks.result: Held: students_safe is set security_invoker=on in 20260406175803 and drill_history is created with security_invoker=on.

local_checks.invariant: SECURITY DEFINER functions reachable by anon/authenticated check the caller before acting on other users' data.
local_checks.result: Enumerated 90+ final SECURITY DEFINER non-trigger functions and matched GRANT/REVOKE statements, including multi-function REVOKE lists. Booking, Stripe, single-session, grading-claim and knowledge functions are revoked from public/anon/authenticated and granted to service_role. Authenticated-granted admin RPCs (approve_signup, dismiss_signup, admin_*_stripe_payment, assign/revoke_reading_center, mcp_* via mcp_require_admin, get_student_email, fts/match_lsatu_content) check user_roles/has_role. memory_* RPCs gate through can_access_memory_namespace.

local_checks.invariant: Admin-only mutation RPCs are not executable by PUBLIC.
local_checks.result: Violated (candidate lsatu:rpc:set_booking_availability_overrides-default-execute-no-admin-check): set_booking_availability_overrides(jsonb) is SECURITY DEFINER, has no role check, and no migration revokes its default PUBLIC EXECUTE. It deletes all future override rows and inserts caller-supplied ones; booking_ranges_for_date uses those rows to replace weekly hours.

local_checks.invariant: SECURITY DEFINER functions pin search_path.
local_checks.result: Held: every enumerated SECURITY DEFINER function sets search_path (public or pg_catalog,public).

local_checks.invariant: Definer RPCs granted to authenticated without caller checks do not disclose protected data.

local_checks.invariant: Every bucket is private and every storage.objects policy binds the object path to the caller or to admin.
local_checks.result: Held at the storage layer: buckets message-attachments, teaching-assets, student-context, external-work-uploads, drill-recordings, model-runs are created public=false. Path policies bind folder[1] to auth.uid() (external-work-uploads, inbox-uploads, drill-recordings), to a conversation the caller participates in (message-attachments), to admin (teaching-assets, student-context), or to a graded section (model-runs). Clients create signed URLs with the user JWT, so a forged message_attachments.storage_path gains nothing. The message-attachments read policy inherits the participant-row pivot recorded under lsatu:rls:conversation_participants-update-conversation_id-pivot in the RLS unit; no separate storage root cause.
